title: Early marker-window stimulus-ID inference from MorseEEG
disposition_reason: The full-cohort importer, probability scorer and paired computational interfaces exist as inactive source. Authentic packet completeness and whether the first500ms contain a reliable information opportunity remain unqualified; nominal26-way chance does not establish distinguishable acoustic prefixes.

scientific_target.question: Does the first500ms of software-marker-locked EEG identify the presented stimulus ID in an unseen participant beyond prespecified contextual and temporal controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Within each task/speed cell, the ordered26-class index of the authenticated raw stimulus trigger; not a shared cross-speed character or participant response-correctness label.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source event sample/value joined to the matching BrainVision stimulus marker; raw code ranges1–26,27–52,53–78 remain speed-specific.
scientific_target.case_unit: Held-person batch of312 trials: two tasks ×three speeds ×26 raw IDs ×two repeats.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 32 participants; six cells and repetitions remain nested within participant.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective early stimulus-ID decoding with task/speed supplied; possible acoustic, order, motor or artifact explanations require matched controls.
exclusions: No complete-character recognition, comprehension, physical acoustic-onset or pre-response claim.
No guessed prefix ceiling from nominal CPM, or silent window extension to improve scores.
No inference of semantic understanding from above-chance raw accuracy or weak-reference gains.

inputs: Labeled fixed62×301 EEG windows from31 complete training people; held-person312 windows with opaque IDs and task/speed cell.
Software-marker0–500ms inclusive at600Hz; PO4/TP8 slots zeroed for every person, remaining60 channels instantaneously average-referenced; no additional filtering/ICA or query-normalization.
forbidden_inputs: Held labels, raw trigger/sample/onset, trial chronology, source filenames, response/duration, behavioral codes, variable-length signals and private inverse.
Cross-fold memories and query-fitted transformations; labels visible in another fold cannot migrate into its held-person context.
observation_contract.case_identity: Current source generates64-hex opaque trial aliases and fold-local group identifiers; original marker sample/value and canonical identity remain operator-only.
observation_contract.split: All32 leave-one-participant-out folds, whole held-person batch together. Any added method selection uses grouped training-person validation; fixed baseline hyperparameters do not tune.
observation_contract.coverage: Nominal9984 trials with every person/cell/class repeated twice; scorer enforces complete32×6×26×2 support. Authentic usable counts/prefix reliability are unverified; six cells are one task.

primary.name: equal-person mean of equal-six-cell balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Class recall averaged over26classes/cell, then equal-six-cell mean/person and equal32-person mean; all192 cell matrices reported.
primary.rationale: Matches existing probability scorer and prevents person/cell/class composition from driving the score. Raw BA must accompany matched gains and reliability evidence.

secondary: Per-cell log loss with declared1e-15 floor;192 confusion matrices; per-person gains against all declared controls.
Class/prefix information-opportunity and reliability assessment before positive or negative decoding interpretation.

comparators.name: fixed_shrinkage_ERP_centroid
comparators.inputs: Only31 training people’s EEG, cell and class labels.
comparators.procedure: Existing equal-person shrinkage centroid reference; fit/freeze separately in each fold; competence unqualified.

comparators.name: prior_and_order_controls
comparators.inputs: Training class priors; separately authenticated chronology supplied only to trusted order diagnostic.
comparators.procedure: Run full matched fold scoring; order effects must not be hidden in the EEG interpretation.

comparators.name: premarker_and_label_permutation
comparators.inputs: The301 samples immediately before marker; training labels permuted within person/cell.
comparators.procedure: Use identical preprocessing, folds, class coverage and matched resources; retain all complete outcomes.

comparators.name: response_and_duration_controls
comparators.inputs: Measured behavior and timing after an independently authenticated source join.
comparators.procedure: Currently unavailable. Do not use positional joins or infer duration from nominal CPM; interpretive qualification remains open.

nuisance_controls: Audit exact one-based BrainVision sample/event join and scaling before window extraction.
Apply identical bad-channel slots and fixed length for everyone to avoid participant-specific masks.
Establish delivered acoustic-prefix identity and reliable EEG opportunity before interpreting26-way performance.
No cleaned derivative with removed trial identity; preserve source chronology privately for order controls.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report paired32-person score vectors and descriptive participant bootstrap. Overlapping training folds, nested cells and repeated prefixes preclude treating9984 trials as independent people; no automatic significance/frontier threshold.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete9984 distinct opaque IDs and valid26-way finite probabilities; missing/duplicate/unknown rows or class-support failures invalidate the panel. Lowest-index argmax ties are fixed; source failures cannot silently reduce cohort or class counts.

implementation.scorer_target: Authentic stimulus-trigger identity when a complete target roster is supplied; no source-paper reconstruction score.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source includes full-cohort preparation, opaque fold projection and complete probability scoring. Nominal shapes/counts and generated engineering controls do not prove native intake or reliable stimulus information.
missing: Authenticated complete raw BrainVision intake and channel/scaling/marker certificates.
Physical-prefix timing/reliability evidence and measured behavioral nuisance joins.
Qualified process/resource isolation, baseline competence and independently executed all-control report.
implementation.execution_evidence: Package explicitly inactive/unqualified; generated engineering data only and no native reference/model run established by inspected source. No new run in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: A no-tools classifier would need the same per-person calibration and fixed EEG windows represented numerically or visually.
direct_observation.boundary: Task/speed context may be supplied but marker code/order/response may not; no decoder or analysis tool may be called in this condition.
missing: Direct observation delivery and complete response collector absent.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential62-slot301-sample EEG renderer with typed channel/time actions.
typed_viewer.boundary: Images must preserve fixed sample/channel content without returning raw arrays, source IDs or fitted labels.
missing: No image viewer transport or viewer trial source supplied.

tool_assisted.representation: Fresh held-person numerical investigation with equal312-case query batch and training-only fitting.
tool_assisted.boundary: P0 forbids transductive fitting; fresh training/query stages and sealed fit state; target feedback withheld.
missing: Qualified physical worker route, authentic complete packets and matched budget evidence.

frozen_program.representation: Frozen decoding procedure and fitting recipe on31people, then held-person inference.
frozen_program.boundary: All32 folds independently reset; same inputs and frozen resources as the investigator; no cross-fold target memory.
missing: Executable admission, authentic source packets and full native controls.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: This revision inspected source and existing construction evidence only. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077, not this task; no direct-observation or typed-viewer model result is asserted here.

summary: State the known answer as speed-specific raw trigger identity, not complete Morse character comprehension.
Make prefix information opportunity, order/premarker/permutation and unavailable behavioral controls consequential to interpretation.
Record exact complete9984-trial support and supplied312-case computational view separately from undelivered direct/viewer access.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registered definition, implementation source and source-bound scientific corrections. Primary-source citations reuse verified source provenance; publisher web checks were unavailable and do not add new source validation.
